overview: At two you read two titles on the post. Your own house plays The Comedy of Errors at the Cross Keys. The Rose plays Set at Maw. No author is named on either. You read the Rose's title and you do not go.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the two titles and did not leave the inn.
